name: http_manager
description: Makes HTTP/REST API calls to external services (Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, GitHub, Spotify, WHOOP, OAuth endpoints, webhooks). Pod-aware auth + per-field body resolution. Multi-step flows (createSession → use accessJwt → chain) are first-class.

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: supporting context (names, dates, URLs, prior results) or ''

outputs.description: Human-readable result text from the planner loop.

arguments_prompt:
http_manager arguments:
- task: the HTTP/REST request.
- information: supporting context. Empty string allowed.

metadata.planner_description: HTTP/REST API specialist: social posts (Bluesky/Mastodon/Reddit), platform APIs (GitHub/Spotify/WHOOP), webhooks, OAuth. NOT browser pages or web search.
